title: Add the product brief
body: T20 from Factory v0: docs/product-brief.md, generated from the operator's short product intent. It says what the task tracker does and for whom. It leaves persistence, auth, hosting, and architecture to Human Gate #1 as open questions, and adds no code.

change.prompt:
Write the product brief for this app from the product intent below. Create only docs/product-brief.md. Do not change any other file, and do not write code.

Product intent, from the operator. Do not widen it:

A deliberately small task/issue tracker. The product is intentionally simple because the main thing being tested is the autonomous software-factory workflow, not application complexity.

The eventual application should allow an authenticated user to:
- create projects
- create, edit and delete tasks
- give tasks a status: Todo, In Progress, Done
- assign a priority
- filter tasks by status and priority
- see a small dashboard/summary

Target user: an individual or small team managing simple software/project tasks.

The brief feeds the next planning steps (requirements, architecture, data model, API and security decisions, acceptance tests, and a task graph), and then Human Gate #1, where the operator answers the open questions. So it says what the product does and for whom, not how it is built.

Rules:
- Do not decide persistence, the database, the auth method or provider, hosting, or cloud architecture. Do not name any database, ORM, auth library, auth protocol, hosting platform, or cloud service, not even to rule one out. Where the product needs one of these, say what it needs in product terms (for example, "a user sees only the projects they can access") and put the decision under Open questions.
- The stack is already fixed by the scaffold: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Node 24. Mention it once, under Constraints. Read README.md and package.json for it. Do not read or cite the vendored skills in .agents/ or .claude/.
- Keep v1 scope to the six capabilities in the intent. Other features (comments, assignees, due dates, labels, notifications, attachments, real-time collaboration, team roles, import and export) go under Non-goals.
- Where the intent leaves a product detail open, choose the simplest reasonable option and write it under Assumptions. If the choice materially changes scope, also list it under Open questions. Examples: the priority levels, whether a small team shares projects or each user has their own, what the dashboard shows, and whether deleting a project deletes its tasks.
- Plain English and short sentences, 500 to 1400 words. No marketing language, no placeholders (TBD, TODO, FIXME, lorem), and no emoji.

Use exactly these headings in this order, with no other level-1 or level-2 headings. Level-3 headings inside a section are fine.

# Product brief: Agent Factory Benchmark
## Summary: two or three sentences. Say that it is the benchmark app for the Factory v0 workflow in olibyte/agent-toolkit, and that it is small on purpose.
## Target users
## Goals: the product goals, and what the benchmark needs from the product: small, well-defined features that can be built as independent tasks and checked by automated tests.
## Scope: the v1 capabilities, each with a short description of what the user can do. Write the statuses exactly as Todo, In Progress, and Done.
## Non-goals
## Success criteria: a bulleted list of observable, testable statements, at least 5.
## Constraints
## Assumptions: a bulleted list, at least 3.
## Open questions: a bulleted list of 3 to 8 questions for the operator at Human Gate #1. Each bullet is one question on one line, ending with a question mark.

The heading lines themselves are only the text before the colon, for example "## Summary".

When you finish, run every verify command listed below yourself, and fix whatever fails.

verify:
python3 -c 'import re; t = open("docs/product-brief.md", encoding="utf-8").read(); sec = {}; cur = None
for l in t.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("## "): cur = l[3:]; sec[cur] = []
    elif cur: sec[cur].append(l)
bullets = lambda s: [l for l in sec[s] if re.match(r"([-*]|\d+\.) ", l)]
body = lambda s: "\n".join(sec[s])
want = ["# Product brief: Agent Factory Benchmark", "## Summary", "## Target users", "## Goals", "## Scope", "## Non-goals", "## Success criteria", "## Constraints", "## Assumptions", "## Open questions"]
heads = [l for l in t.splitlines() if re.match(r"#{1,2} ", l)]
assert t.splitlines()[0] == want[0], "title"
assert heads == want, heads
n = len(t.split()); assert 500 <= n <= 1400, f"{n} words"
assert not re.search(r"\b(TBD|TODO|FIXME)\b", t) and "lorem" not in t.lower(), "placeholder"
assert not re.search("[\U0001F300-\U0001FAFF\u2600-\u27BF]", t), "emoji"
'

python3 -c 'import re; t = open("docs/product-brief.md", encoding="utf-8").read(); sec = {}; cur = None
for l in t.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("## "): cur = l[3:]; sec[cur] = []
    elif cur: sec[cur].append(l)
bullets = lambda s: [l for l in sec[s] if re.match(r"([-*]|\d+\.) ", l)]
body = lambda s: "\n".join(sec[s])
s = body("Scope")
for w in ["Todo", "In Progress", "Done"]: assert w in s, w
for w in ["project", "create", "edit", "delete", "priority", "filter", "dashboard"]: assert w in s.lower(), w
assert not re.search(r"assignee|due date|attachment|notification", s, re.I), "scope creep"
assert "Factory v0" in body("Summary") and "agent-toolkit" in body("Summary"), "summary"
assert re.search(r"authenticat|sign[ -]?in", t, re.I), "auth"
assert len(bullets("Success criteria")) >= 5, "success criteria"
assert len(bullets("Assumptions")) >= 3, "assumptions"
q = bullets("Open questions"); assert 3 <= len(q) <= 8 and all(l.rstrip().endswith("?") for l in q), q
'

python3 -c 'import re; t = open("docs/product-brief.md", encoding="utf-8").read(); sec = {}; cur = None
for l in t.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("## "): cur = l[3:]; sec[cur] = []
    elif cur: sec[cur].append(l)
bullets = lambda s: [l for l in sec[s] if re.match(r"([-*]|\d+\.) ", l)]
body = lambda s: "\n".join(sec[s])
bad = r"\b(postgres(ql)?|mysql|mariadb|sqlite|dynamo(db)?|mongo(db)?|prisma|drizzle|supabase|firebase|redis|cognito|auth0|clerk|next-?auth|auth\.js|lucia|oauth|oidc|saml|jwt|lambda|fargate|ecs|eks|ec2|amplify|s3|rds|aurora|aws|azure|gcp|vercel|netlify|heroku|docker|kubernetes|graphql|trpc)\b"
m = sorted({x.group(0) for x in re.finditer(bad, t, re.I)}); assert not m, m
'
